disableAssistantLinks.title: Never open AI assistants
disableAssistantLinks.description: Sada only copies the question; it never opens ChatGPT, Gemini or any other assistant.

disableRival.title: No competitor reading
disableRival.description: Hide the Rival comparison, so Sada never reads another company's website.

disableSiteScan.title: Current page only
disableSiteScan.description: Sada reads only the page the user is on, never other pages of the site.

disableOnDeviceAI.title: No built-in browser AI
disableOnDeviceAI.description: Sada does not use the browser's on-device language model for drafts and rewrites.

hideContactOffers.title: Hide offers
hideContactOffers.description: Hide the buttons to book a call or email AYKA Technologies.
